## Results

### Preparations

#### Load R libraries

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(cowplot)
library(ggrepel)
```

#### Visualization settings for the report

```{r}
options(digits = 3) # visualizations of tables
theme_set(theme_classic())
```

#### Custom functions

```{r}
source(here("code/functions/helpers.R"))
source(here("code/functions/figure_helpers.R"))
source(here("code/functions/color_scales.R"))
```

#### Set input and output directories

Show base path to the project that is used in the analysis.

```{r}
here()
```

Set output data directory and create if it does not exist.

```{r}
datestamp <- get_datestamp()
output_dir <- set_output_dir(here("manuscript", str_glue("Figure4_{datestamp}")))
```

Make lines in plots a bit bigger

```{r}
geom_point <- function(...) {
  ggplot2::geom_point(..., size = 2)
}
geom_hline <- function(...) {
  ggplot2::geom_hline(..., size = 0.5)
}
geom_errorbar <- function(...) {
  ggplot2::geom_errorbar(..., size = 0.5)
}
```

### Load data

```{r}
read_dataset <- function(file_path) {
  df <- read_csv(file_path,
    col_types = cols(
      is_control = col_factor(levels = control_levels),
      significant_hit = col_factor(levels = significant_hit_levels)
    )
  )
  print(dim(df))
  print(head(df))
  print(table(df$is_control))
  return(df)
}
control_levels <- c(
  "siRNA control", "migration inhibitor positive control",
  "proliferation inhibitor positive control", "candidate"
)
significant_hit_levels <- c(control_levels, "not significant", "FDR < 0.1")
proliferation <- read_dataset(here(output_dir, "proliferation.csv"))
migration <- read_dataset(here(output_dir, "migration.csv"))
proliferation_SRB <- read_dataset(here(output_dir, "proliferation_SRB.csv"))
```

### Figure 4A

```{r fig.height=14/2.54, fig.width=18/2.54}
make_proliferation_SRB_plot <- function(df) {
  min_SRB <- min(df$mean_proliferation_SRB)
  p <- df |>
    # the background
    ggplot(aes(x = target, y = mean_proliferation_SRB, color = significant_hit)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 100, linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 80, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 50, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey30") +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Relative proliferation SRB", color = NULL) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "bottom",
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1, size = 6)
    ) +
    annotate("text", x = Inf, y = 80, label = "80%", hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.1, color = "grey") +
    annotate("text", x = Inf, y = 50, label = "50%", hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.1, color = "grey") +
    # the data
    geom_point() +
    geom_errorbar(aes(
      ymin = ifelse(
        mean_proliferation_SRB - SEM_proliferation_SRB < min_SRB, 
        min_SRB, 
        mean_proliferation_SRB - SEM_proliferation_SRB
      ),
      ymax = mean_proliferation_SRB + SEM_proliferation_SRB
    ), width = 0.2) +
    scale_color_manual(values = siRNA_colors)
}

# Sort by proliferation decrease
figure_4a <- proliferation_SRB |>
  mutate(target = factor(target, levels = unique(proliferation_SRB$target))) |>
  make_proliferation_SRB_plot()
figure_4a

proliferation_SRB |>
  # Sort by migration speed reduction
  mutate(target = factor(target, levels = unique(migration$target))) |>
  make_proliferation_SRB_plot()

target_order <- proliferation_SRB |>
  arrange(is_control, target) |>
  pull(target)
proliferation_SRB |>
  # Sort by alphabetical
  mutate(target = factor(target, levels = target_order)) |>
  make_proliferation_SRB_plot()

save_plot(here(output_dir, "figure_4a.png"), figure_4a, base_height = 2 / 3 * page_height, base_width = page_width)
```

### Figure 4B

```{r}
make_proliferation_plot <- function(df) {
  p <- df |>
    ggplot(aes(x = target, y = mean_prol, color = significant_hit)) +
    annotate("text", x = Inf, y = 0.8, label = "80%", hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.1, color = "grey") +
    annotate("text", x = Inf, y = 0.5, label = "50%", hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.1, color = "grey") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0.8, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey30") +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, NA), breaks = seq(0, max(proliferation$mean_prol) + 0.2, 0.2)) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Relative proliferation - confluency", color = NULL) +
    geom_point() +
    geom_errorbar(aes(
      ymin = ifelse(mean_prol - SEM_prol < 0, 0, mean_prol - SEM_prol),
      ymax = mean_prol + SEM_prol
    ), width = 0.2) +
    scale_color_manual(values = siRNA_colors) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "bottom",
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1, size = 6)
    )
  return(p)
}

# Sort by proliferation decrease
proliferation |>
  mutate(target = factor(target, levels = unique(proliferation$target))) |>
  make_proliferation_plot()

figure_4b <- proliferation |>
  # Sort by SRB proliferation decrease
  mutate(target = factor(target, levels = unique(proliferation_SRB$target))) |>
  make_proliferation_plot()
figure_4b

target_order <- proliferation |>
  arrange(is_control, target) |>
  pull(target)
proliferation |>
  # Sort by alphabetical
  mutate(target = factor(target, levels = target_order)) |>
  make_proliferation_plot()
```


```{r}
save_plot(here(output_dir, "figure_4b.png"), figure_4b, base_height = 2 / 3 * page_height, base_width = page_width)
```

### Figure 4C

Compare to the value of migration speed of the mock control:

```{r}
migration_mock <- migration |>
  filter(target == "mock") |>
  pull(mean_migration)
migration_mock
```

```{r}
make_migration_plot <- function(df) {
  p <- df |>
    ggplot(aes(x = target, y = mean_migration, color = significant_hit)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = migration_mock, linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0.8 * migration_mock, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey30") +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, NA)) + # , breaks = seq(0,max(migration$mean_migration) + 0.2, 0.2)) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Migration speed (µm/h)", color = NULL) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "bottom",
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1, size = 6)
    ) +
    annotate("text", x = Inf, y = 0.8 * migration_mock, label = "80%", hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.1, color = "grey") +
    geom_point() +
    geom_errorbar(aes(
      ymin = ifelse(mean_migration - SEM_migration < 0, 0, mean_migration - SEM_migration),
      ymax = mean_migration + SEM_migration
    ), width = 0.2) +
    scale_color_manual(values = siRNA_colors)
  return(p)
}
# Sort by migration decrease
migration |>
  mutate(target = factor(target, levels = unique(migration$target))) |>
  make_migration_plot()

figure_4c <- migration |>
  # Sort by SRB proliferation decrease
  mutate(target = factor(target, levels = unique(proliferation_SRB$target))) |>
  make_migration_plot()
figure_4c

target_order <- migration |>
  arrange(is_control, target) |>
  pull(target)

migration |>
  # Sort by alphabetical
  mutate(target = factor(target, levels = target_order)) |>
  make_migration_plot()

figure_4c
save_plot(here(output_dir, "figure_4c.png"), figure_4c, base_height = 2 / 3 * page_height, base_width = page_width)
```
### Figure 4

```{r fig.height=14/2.54, fig.width=18/2.54}
figure_4 <- plot_grid(
  figure_4a + theme(legend.position = "none", axis.title.y = element_text(hjust = 0.3)),
  figure_4b + theme(legend.position = "none", axis.title.y = element_text(hjust = -0.2)),
  figure_4c + theme(axis.title.y = element_text(hjust = 0.2)),
  labels = LETTERS[1:3],
  ncol = 1
)
figure_4
```

```{r}
(output_file <- here(output_dir, "Figure_4.png"))
save_plot(output_file, figure_4, base_height = 0.8 * page_height, base_width = page_width)
```
